column3: “Stone someone pours out copper” is rendered “from rock copper is smelted.”
The verse is difficult; “away from with a sojourner” is rendered “far from habitation,” and the meaning is uncertain.
“From weeping rivers” is rendered “streams from flowing”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Price” is rendered “acquisition”; the identity of the precious stones is uncertain.
The Hebrew has “the Lord” here; NASB keeps it.
